summary: This study investigates the nutrient critical levels in soil and grapevines leaves that contribute to high-quality grape composition in a subtropical climate. The Journal of Plant Nutrition published the research in 2026.
title: Nutrient critical levels in soil and grapevines leaves to high-quality grape composition in subtropical climate
